assets.prompt: Product photo of a white plaster classical sculpture of a standing robed Greek figure holding a scroll, on a square white plinth, slightly chipped, full body three-quarter view, centred, plain light grey studio background, even soft lighting, no text.
assets.reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): no inscription, lettering, logos or marks. A generic classical togate figure with a scroll, in the manner of Greco-Roman portrait statues (a public-domain genre); not identified as a copy of a specific known sculpture, and the idealised face is not a recognisable likeness of a real person. A sculpture, not a character.
